description: This course will help you understand and adapt to Snowflake's planned move to default Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). We'll cover why this shift is important for security, introduce new tools like the Trust Center, and show you how to use MFA policies and tools effectively.

title: Snowflake Multi-Factor Authentication Essentials (MFA)
